summary: This Form 8-K, filed by Structured Obligations Corporation on behalf of Select Notes Trust LT 2004-1, reports a routine distribution to certificate holders under Item 8.01. The filing consists of a trustee report for the June 1, 2026 interest distribution date, showing $0.00 interest received. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change is present. The document merely satisfies ongoing reporting obligations for an asset-backed security trust.
